name: Remove Teams (Personal)
description: Removes the personal Microsoft Teams app from Windows if it is installed, reducing background activity and Start menu clutter for users who do not use Teams with a personal account.

description_i18n.en: Removes the personal Microsoft Teams app from Windows if it is installed, reducing background activity and Start menu clutter for users who do not use Teams with a personal account.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt die persönliche Microsoft-Teams-App aus Windows und reduziert Hintergrundaktivität sowie Unordnung im Startmenü für Nutzer ohne privaten Teams-Account.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime l'application Microsoft Teams personnelle de Windows afin de réduire l'activité en arrière-plan et l'encombrement du menu Démarrer si vous n'utilisez pas de compte personnel.

warnings.title: Personal account apps removed
warnings.message: This action removes Microsoft Teams applications associated with personal accounts. If you use a work or school account, those versions will remain unaffected.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Removes installed and provisioned Appx packages matching the name pattern 'MicrosoftTeams'.
